issues.description: I took this today, July 25, 2023. It has been like this since we bought the house. We are at the bottom of Observatory Hill. The rain gathers, floods our drive way, and cannot move back out onto the street. In the winter it freezes and I get complaints and tickets but it’s impossible to fix with salt or a pump because of the frost freeze cycle. Daily. Many interventions promised. A re-grade of the street failed. The hump in the road just traps the storm water and snow melt in. My husband is 81 and a fall risk. We don’t need another winter of an ice rink.
the catch basin/sewer on the corner of Julia and Medford Street needs to be cleaned out.  the water rises over the sidewalk on every rain storm.
